q1_prime.question: Can 12 neutral (n1) hits cover all A1 movies that humans scored 2?
q1_prime.batch_rule: PASS if all runs with |A1_two|>0 satisfy A1_two ⊆ N (vacuous pass per run when A1_two empty)

q1_legacy_recall.note: Legacy diagnostic only (candidate-pool neutral union ⊇ all A1 hits); not a gate fail

a1_oracle.note: Gate Q1′ = n1 neutral coverage of human-scored A1 twos; q1_legacy_recall = candidate-pool neutral union superset (diagnostic)
